jobs.title: Senior Marketing Executive
jobs.reason: This is a B2B marketing role requiring 5+ years of experience (a hard exclusion) plus mandatory TIC/professional-services marketing background, marketing-automation tooling and AI content production — all off the candidate's profile. Field, skills and seniority all mismatch.

jobs.title: Audio Visual Producer (Factual) - EXTEND
jobs.reason: This is a media production role requiring proven experience producing commercial video/podcast content and overseeing multi-camera shoots — entirely off the candidate's IR/policy/research profile and lacking the specialist production skills. It is also a senior producer role expecting demonstrated commercial production track record, and is restricted to the BBC Extend disability programme. Field mismatch alone forces Low.

jobs.title: Investment Manager
jobs.reason: This is a senior investment/finance role (£90k-£150k salary, Manager title working with an Investment Director), which is entirely off the candidate's IR/policy profile and demands specialist finance experience the candidate lacks. Mismatch on field, skills and seniority.

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee – Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: The deadline of 15 January 2026 has passed relative to today (27 June 2026), so the role is closed. It is also an expert advisory committee seeking established experts, not an entry-level position, and reads as an unpaid/volunteer call rather than a salaried job.
